conclusion: The supported endpoint is resolved and genuinely authenticated for reads. It cannot be used as the unattended full-live execution adapter while preserving the current mandatory confirmation policy, and its advertised cancel contract independently prevents unattended lifecycle control. No confirmation was bypassed and no credential was copied into the local daemon.
remaining_provider_decision: Robinhood must identify a separately supported local-client authorization/contract with unattended place, cancel, exact-reference lookup, exhaustive conditional-order coverage, and durable renewal semantics; otherwise the owner must explicitly select and authorize a different supported broker.
